chunks: The reconciliation between the two reports in this meaning is:
2018 - What Abū Baṣīr narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام:
He asked him whether walking is better or riding, so he said: “If a man is wealthy and he walks so that his expense may be less, then riding is better.”
ai.seo_question: Is walking or riding better during hajj for a wealthy person?
ai.summary: This hadith explains how to reconcile reports about walking and riding in hajj. It indicates that for a wealthy person, choosing to walk merely to reduce spending is not preferable; in such a case, riding is better.
